description:
## What

In `src/fetcher/crest_http_client.cr`, the new DNS shim methods (lines 25-34, 47, 308-313, 318-330) all call the delegate as `Fetcher::DnsCache.X`. The rest of the file uses unqualified module-local references (`HeaderBuilder.build`, `RateLimiterRegistry.clear`, `Crest::Request.execute`). Inside `module Fetcher`, the `Fetcher::` prefix on `DnsCache` is inconsistent noise.

## Why

Style consistency. Also makes the file slightly easier to read.

## How

In `src/fetcher/crest_http_client.cr`, replace `Fetcher::DnsCache.X` with `DnsCache.X` in each shim method (7 call sites).

## Done when

- Grep `Fetcher::DnsCache` in crest_http_client.cr returns no hits.
- Full spec suite still green (415 examples).
title: Style: drop Fetcher:: prefix on DnsCache in CrestHttpClient shims
